newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-INDEPENDIENTE WIN AGAIN UNDER MENOTTI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INDEPENDIENTE WIN AGAIN UNDER MENOTTI.

text.p: Independiente won their second match under veteran coach Cesar Luis Menotti, beating Newell's Old Boys 4-0 in the Argentine championship on Wednesday.
Former Argentine international Jorge Burruchaga scored two of the goals, one from a penalty and one from a free-kick.
Menotti, who led Argentina to World Cup victory in 1978, ended a two-year absence from soccer when he took over at the club two weeks ago.
Independiente, who have scored seven goals and conceded none in their two games since then, are the only team to have won both their opening games.
Alfio Basile, another former national team coach, was also on the winning side as Racing Club celebrated his arrival with a surprise 3-2 win at defending champions Velez Sarsfield.
He accepted the Racing job on Saturday.
